questions.question:
Seven boys A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing towards the north (not necessarily in the same order). E is at one of the ends. A is fifth to the left of E. B is not the immediate neighbour of A or E. C is third to the left of B. Only D is sitting between A and B. Only two boys are sitting between D and F. Which of the following statements is/are correct?

I. G is to the immediate left of D.

II. A and B are the neighbours of D.
questions.solution:
**Given : **

 
• Seven boys →** A, B, C, D, E, F and G** 
 
• All the boys are sitting in a row, facing towards the north.

**​Explanation :**

1) E is at one of the ends. 

2) A is fifth to the left of E. 

As A is fifth to the left of E, therefore the only position for E will be at the right end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8926ab491ffdd7e026cdad1345719b611ad2318fd8686f3e0648702f5b33f17.png] 

3) B is not the immediate neighbour of A or E. 

4) C is third to the left of B.

As B is not adjacent to either A or E, therefore two possible positions for B is fourth and fifth position from the left end but as C is third to the left of B, thus the only possible position for B is fourth position from the left end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdf65ef378c5ee376d95a8bd3c79ee4f8cb67e9229ffba5b2609630f49ba7a33.png] 

5) Only D is sitting between A and B.

6) Only two boys are sitting between D and F.

After positioning D and F, only one position is left which will be occupied by the only boy left i.e G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fb8a2774b389b10ae8ad04004024552ae901d12b3182c81cba6fd5a159734d6.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement :

I. G is to the immediate left of D → Incorrect 

II. A and B are the neighbours of D →** Correct**

Here, **Only II statement is correct.**

Hence, **"Only II"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
The percentage of marks obtained by seven girls G1, G2, G3, G4, G5, G6 and G7 in a class are compared. All the girls have obtained different percentages of marks. G4 has the lowest percentage. G3 has a higher percentage than G5, but less than G1. The percentage of G6 is less than G2. G7 has the highest percentage. G1 has a percentage greater than only three girls.

Who has the third lowest percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given : **

 
• Seven girls → **G1, G2, G3, G4, G5, G6 and G7**
 
• All the girls have obtained different percentages of marks.

**​Explanation :**

1) G4 has the lowest percentage.

2) G7 has the highest percentage.

G7 > _ > _ > _ > _ > _ > G4

3) G1 has a percentage greater than only three girls.

4) G3 has a higher percentage than G5, but less than G1.

G7 > _ > _ > G1 > G3 > G5 > G4

5) The percentage of G6 is less than G2.

**G7 > G2 > G6 > G1 > G3 > G5 > G4**

Thus, according to the final arrangement G3 has the third lowest percentage.

Hence, **"G3"** is the correct answer.
